D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue, probably of 335-341, Reece period 17, on a small module flan. Obverse description: Bust possibly laureate right, draped ?and cuirassed. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with [probably] one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 15.2mm,…
